segments.dry: Reviewers describe the formula as well suited to dry skin, delivering a hydrating finish that several say does not feel drying, with one calling it perfect for her dry skin.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin or an oily T-zone note the formula can feel oily or slide off over time, and recommend setting it with powder to hold the finish.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, rosacea-prone, or allergy-prone skin repeatedly report no irritation, stinging, or breakouts, describing it as gentle enough for all-day wear.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the formula does not add shine or cause breakouts, though some use a setting powder on oilier areas to control shine.

concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including some with combination skin, describe the finish as non-greasy, but a few with oily skin found it slides or turns shiny without a setting powder.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts or clogged pores, though one reviewer sensitive to oil had a slight breakout until she changed the order of applying it after her primer.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including some with dry skin, describe the formula as hydrating rather than drying, though one reviewer felt it was not very hydrating.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with sensitive, rosacea-prone, or eczema-prone skin consistently report no irritation, stinging, or flare-ups from this sunscreen, including with daily use.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight, serum-like texture that absorbs fast
Blends without white cast on tan or deep skin tones
Tint looks too dark or orange before blending in
Small 30ml bottle empties quickly for the price
Subtle bronze glow works alone or under makeup
Can flake or transfer under powder after several hours

extraits.titre: Really nice product, not suitable for my skin
extraits.texte: At first when I saw the color, I was worried it would be too dark. But it blends in very well and gave a nice glow underneath my makeup and blended well with makeup. I'm sensitive to oil and when I read the ingredient list I knew it might cause problems and I did have a slight breakout but once I changed it to my primer first and then the spf I didn't have as many issues.

Living in Southern California Sunscreen is a necessity year round and having a Bronzing tint is a bonus. I used the Bloomeffects Dew Serum this weekend in Santa Barbara and I feel it protected my face for 3 hours I was in direct sunlight. The product was a bit oily for me which is why I left 4 stars. The product would be great for those with dry skin.

extraits.titre: Glow shade works for fair neutral skin tones
extraits.texte: I purchased this product and am NOT incentivized in any way to write this review. I have fair neutral skin and have a very hard time finding tinted mineral sunscreen that does not make me look orange. The "Glow" shade blends in with my skin to the point where it is completely undetectable. It has a thin consistency that makes it hard to believe it can be SPF 50. My skin is on the drier side but is acne prone and sensitive, and after this product sets, its like I have nothing on my skin which is so nice for a sunscreen. Love that there is zero fragrance. My only gripe is the high price for such a small amount of product. But it is a really good one!

I am ridiculously sensitive to most facial products and that includes spf either chemical or mineral. This is the first sunscreen that I can wear all day without irritation. My biggest fear is that this little company gets bought by a big one and they ruin this formula.
This sunscreen has become my holy grail product for my sensitive, rosacea and eczema prone skin. It gives me a lovely glow and I don't feel the need to wear foundation over it.

The Dew serum bronze tinted sunscreen is amazing on my skin and match my skin tone very well. I did not have any irritation or discomfort when I applied it on my face, which is great because I have a sensitive combinations skin. When I applied it, I let it set for 15 minutes and go in with a finishing powder on my oily areas and brush the excess powder off. I purchased a second one because it is so good and will be continuing to purchase more! Love it!

Love this sunscreen! I appreciate mineral sunscreen because I have sensitive skin and the glow I get is amazing. It's perfect for my dry skin. The packaging is beautiful however I do wish it was a little more practical for travel. I'm constantly putting my sunscreen in my purse to reapply when I run errands or when I travel locally or to another country and wish it was a little more compact or in a tube.
